scope: Previously exposed March completed-count audit, not stock accuracy
limitations: March previously exposed; no untouched generalization claim
Only historical completed counts, no observed stock or unmet demand truth
Neural ablations have equal optimization budgets; tree uses a different fixed family-specific budget and smaller unique training sample coverage
XGBoost uses frozen source-only embeddings; not a raw-only standalone baseline
Explicit-calendar removal leaves calendar information in priors
No-weather removal is absence of all54 values/masks, not a real-time observed weather availability experiment
Runtime weather and recent-stock proxy differ from historical training signals
Only one temporal split, two seeds, fixed hyperparameters; no global-best proof
No automatic production promotion; no API opened
